title: Avocado and Corn Salsa
description: A fresh and zesty salsa with sweet corn, creamy avocado, and bright lime—great as a dip or topping for tortilla chips.

steps.instruction: Cook corn if needed, then cut kernels off the cob.
In a large bowl, combine corn, avocado, red onion, red bell pepper, and garlic.
Add olive oil, red wine vinegar, cumin, red pepper flakes, and oregano.
Squeeze lime juice over the mixture and gently toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately or chill briefly before serving.
